name: Fewest Batches to Reach a Quota
desc:
A job processes records in batches whose size must be one of batch_sizes (each size can be used any number of times). Your task is to return the minimum number of batches whose sizes add up to exactly quota, or -1 if it is impossible. quota = 0 needs 0 batches.

Example

For batch_sizes = [1, 3, 4], quota = 6, the output should be

2
[execution time limit] 4 seconds (py3)
[memory limit] 1 GB
[input] array.integer batch_sizes
[input] integer quota
[output] integer
hints: dp[x] = nombre minimal de lots pour faire exactement x ; dp[0] = 0.
dp[x] = 1 + min(dp[x - s]) pour chaque taille s <= x. Contre-exemple du glouton : tailles [1, 3, 4], quota 6.
summary_fr: Nombre minimal de lots (tailles réutilisables) dont la somme vaut exactement le quota, -1 si impossible. Le glouton « toujours le plus gros » est faux.
